notes.text: Failing sites go to a temporary pool and an archive, not to review
PortfolioRank is now dark only: every visitor gets the dark look, whatever their device setting or earlier choice, and the theme switch is gone.
Profiles now say "Not measured yet" for a Lighthouse result that has not been measured, instead of waiting for it to run.
Read the finished page, and know a page that is not the site
A site the owner ruled off the list no longer comes back by itself
Sites that turned away our second visit with a bot check are captured again, with their phone view taken from the same visit.
Report a problem with a site's screenshot or measurements
Gemini is asked only whether a page is a portfolio and its roles
Honest check scores, and blog or link-in-bio hosts are never portfolios
Count project links right on the five sites the version 3 trial got wrong
Every listed portfolio now gets its starting rank from clear code checks as soon as it is measured, and the AI's letter no longer stands in for a site's grade.
A domain that has expired and now shows a parking page is taken off the rankings instead of staying listed as a working portfolio.

Project links are now read from your projects section and your own projects page, and count as working when at least three load; footer years written as "2026 ©" are recognised, and content shown only on phones is counted.
Only links you present as projects count toward your project links now, so certificates, employers and footer credits no longer do, and project sections in other languages are recognised.
A portfolio the community list drops now stays on PortfolioRank, and 25 sites dropped earlier are back; only our own checks and an owner's removal take a site off.
A portfolio's automated check points, fix list and report card now reflect its latest re-measure instead of the facts from the day it was graded.
When an owner removes their site or hides its grade, that now covers every spelling of the address, and a removed site can't be added again.
Resume, GitHub, contact and project checks now see buttons and pages that load late, so fewer sites are wrongly marked as missing them.
A site the community list respells keeps its grade, votes and rank.
Sites that stopped working are now re-checked on time, every hour one is due.
Screenshots on /shots links load again.
Lighthouse scores and page checks on portfolio pages load instantly once measured, and show the date they were measured.
Share image for link previews
Undo a deleted list, a removed portfolio or an unlike instead of confirming first
PortfolioRank's own cleanup: roster-aware jobs, weekly health check, /removed
3.5 first with catch-up on 3.1, shared pacing, request log, re-grade history
AI grades read your page text, and code checks your links and contact details
Grades and AI votes from 3.5 only, no fallback to 3.1
Pacific quota day, cut-off answers fail, contact redaction, Turso reads, full backups
Weekly polls back end: tables, read and vote API, nightly generation
Weekly model watch reports Gemini model changes to the owner
Staging site at staging.portfoliorank.n8builds.dev, deployed before production
Grade my portfolio back end, switched off until the redesign
Back end for games, badges, claims, live stats and report downloads, behind GAMES_V2
The redesign's shared shell on every page, with a light theme
Shorter posts, real paragraphs, tie-aware facts, staged writer
The redesigned home page and /me on real data
Cap PortfolioRank's Tavily use at 200 credits a month and show usage in admin quota
Staged writer is the default for the content engine
Route Workers AI through the portfoliorank-ai gateway with a hard rate limit
Blog images from an owner-approved library, at most 40 free AI images a day
A settings menu, self-serve data download and account deletion
Grade your portfolio, How grading works, and self-serve portfolio removal
The redesigned leaderboard and Play, with Guess the percentile behind GAMES_V2
Answer GET /healthz with ok for uptime monitors
Lock the staging site inside the Worker
A polls page with this week's poll, what is coming and past results
The blog: short posts from PortfolioRank's own data, each one read by a person before it goes out.
Image library review with tabs, Make now feedback and 40 a day
Write a draft now, rewrites, guidelines and a scorecard for blog drafts
Automatic library images run once a day at 23:15 UTC
PortfolioRank moves to portfoliorank.dev
Privacy, terms and removal pages, linked from every page's footer
An Alerts page with a Send test alert button
Owner goals with a weekly check and a calendar invite when one is first reached
/admin is an overview with a card for each admin page, one admin layout and a usage page
A Limits page with every free allowance against its limit
Blog posts tell search engines their author, last edit and place in the blog
Grading budget goes to new sites, Lighthouse for every graded site, safer AI prompts
Site alert emails say they come through Cloudflare Email Service, not Kit
Code plans each blog post and Gemini writes it in one plain-text call
Tiers by ELO kept incrementally, shown only while RANKING_V2 is on
With RANKING_V2 on, reports, share images, /me and emails show the tier by ELO
Add your portfolio and the free tools, behind TOOLS_ENABLED
Profiles tell search engines who the person is, described from their grade
The sitemap is an index of pages, blog and profile files, with real change dates
Sign in with an emailed one-time link, beside GitHub
Get new blog posts by email through Kit, off in production until launch
Find new portfolios automatically, every run off by default
Checks re-run only when a portfolio changed or got old, behind FRESHNESS_ENABLED
Verify ownership by file or meta tag; check a site exists before adding
Letters from day one, S earned, D reserved
Splash screens that ask for a click are clicked through first
Strong page signals keep a not-a-portfolio site listed
A capped re-check of not-a-portfolio grades
Close a dialog on top of the page before the screenshots
A template is not a fault
A template never counts in the checks score
Review queue for proposed status changes, applied only on confirm
Review passes apply themselves behind REVIEW_AUTO_APPLY, with Undo
Review rows that both graders agree on are now confirmed automatically, with Undo on /admin/review.
Keep the 543 re-check verdicts in excluded.json; dead sites rechecked
Portfolios that stop loading are hidden within a day and come back on their own, with their grade and votes, when they work again.

Account export and deletion include grades requested while signed in
Sign everyone out once, restore undone removals weekly
A grade that can't take screenshots shows its free checks instead of "couldn't grade"
Each leaderboard view shows exactly one gold, one silver and one bronze

Every table is in the schema, so staging and restores have them all

Leaderboard rows show each site's icon, not a placeholder

Rankings only count votes on the pairs PortfolioRank shows you, so nobody can vote their own site to the top.
Practice votes can't be fished for, and claims can't overspend
Claiming a portfolio now needs proof on the site itself (a link to your GitHub profile or the verification tag), so nobody else can claim or remove your portfolio.
30-day GitHub account age for votes and owner actions; admin by id; origin checks
Removing a portfolio needs the meta tag, waits a day and can be undone
Hiding a grade needs owner-only proof; a github.io site belongs to its account
"use the free tier" only queues the grade, never calling Gemini on our key
